page.layout: One page: the outer cover of the binding, blank except for a gold-tooled emblem (a lion holding a shield) centred on the board. No printed text.
page.notes: Outer binding of vellum or limp parchment, not a printed page. The gold lion emblem in the centre is a tooled stamp on the cover, not printed text, so it is described here and not transcribed. Faint marks and stains on the left edge and near the top are not printed text. A dark mark and smudged handwriting on the left edge are a shelf mark or label and are excluded. Spine ties or sewing holes are visible on the right edge.
